text:
maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize the observability onboarding roadmap for the Marketplace listing + Datadog/OTel integration. Can we agree on the minimum deliverables?

sam: +1. I sketched a minimal set: traces (service/name + span latency), token-level metrics (tokens/s, tokens/latency), request-level latency p50/p95/p99, error_rate, and an example dashboard.

jin: For OTEL collector config, we should provide a ready-to-drop yaml that uses the Datadog exporter. I'll paste a snippet we can include in the docs: 
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: 
      http:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "<DD_API_KEY>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

alex: Nice. Marketing needs a 1-pager + sample dashboards (PNG + JSON) and a short co-branded blurb for the Marketplace listing. Want to aim for a soft launch next Tue?

rob: Sales ask — include a slide about Dedicated and Private deployment observability: how to forward telemetry from VPC/on-prem to Datadog (via agent/forwarder) and privacy implications.

maria: Good call, Rob. Add a short note: for Private deployments we recommend a customer-managed Datadog forwarder or proxy; include an HSM/KMS callout for logs/keys.

sam: I'll draft the dashboard JSON (Datadog JSON export) with the must-have widgets: tokens/sec timeseries, p95 latency, KV cache hit rate, and an alerts panel. Quick example monitor query for alerts: 
`avg(last_5m):avg:rdw.request.latency{environment:prod} > 750`

jin: Also include tracing conventions: set resource.service.name=redwood-inference, attributes: deployment.mode=(hosted|dedicated|private), model.name, model.version, customer.id (hashed). That lets customers filter traces per-tenant without leaking PII.

maria: Perfect. Can we add a short troubleshooting section in the docs for common problems (OTLP not reaching Datadog, missing service.name, high tag cardinality)?

sam: I'll add the troubleshooting list + a small runbook for common alerts.

alex: I can draft the 1-pager and the joint blog outline. Need final assets by EOD Fri to get legal review.

maria: Action items:
- jin: produce full OTEL collector example + agent-forwarder guide (private) — due Thu
- sam: dashboard JSON + troubleshooting runbook — due Thu
- alex: 1-pager + blog draft + co-brand blurb — due Fri EOD
- rob: compile sales enablement slide about observability options — due Fri

jin: noted, I'll open a PR with the collector config and a README. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/integrations/pull/123

sam: I'll attach the dashboard JSON to the same repo and a PNG preview.

datadog-bot: Integration checklist: 1) Exporter config 2) Dashboard JSON 3) Monitor queries 4) Troubleshooting guide 5) Co-marketing assets — status: pending

maria: Timeline check — if everything lands by Fri, we can aim for a soft Marketplace publish Mon next week and a joint blog the week after. Anyone blocking?

alex: No blockers from marketing, but need final legal approval on the blurb.

rob: No technical blockers from sales. Might want a short SI note for partners that do on-prem installs.

maria: Great. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to review PRs. Tentative: 10:30am PT.

sam: 10:30 works for me.

jin: Works. I'll bring the sample collector conf and a small demo .

alex: I'll bring the draft 1-pager.

maria: Thanks team — I'll create the calendar invite and drop the draft agenda in the thread. :thumbsup:
